description:
Get a specific document by ID from Holded.

Args:
  - doc_type (string): Document type (required)
  - document_id (string): The document ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Document details including line items, totals, and payment status.

doc_type.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, salesorder, waybill, proform, purchase, purchaserefund, purchaseorder

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_get_document
title: Get Holded Document
